translation:
They say even great men have great lusts,
so it goes without saying for ordinary men.
What are you talking about?
No, it's nothing. I'm just talking to myself.
Your instructions?

I'm not going to tell you to do anything in
particular.

As long as you're friendly with the members of
the computer society, that should do the trick.

I'm sorry to say, but I don't think the
computer society has high female resistance.

If I soften their attitude, it should be easier
to get them to talk.
Alright, shall we go?
Hiya~
Y-you guys again?!

No matter how many times you come, we have
nothing more to tell you!
Now! Asahina, Nagato!
O-okay.

Um, uhh… we've come to… support you after all
your hard work during this summer camp~
…Eh?
Have some tea.

Asahina is awkward, and Nagato is completely
monotone.

However, for the time being it seems their
appeal is working.

Behold, the computer society members' cheeks
are dyed red. They can't stop fidgeting…

You've become hopelessly stricken by their
appeal, haven't you?
Um, well, I came to bring you tea.
I know it's not much, but…
There is also a pot. I will use the outlet.
Rejoice, Computer Research Society!

It's not every day that you get ambushed by
the Nagato-Asahina tag team.
It's a dream combination, after all.

O-oh of course, I'm sorry… for not being more
considerate.

No, it's fine. Our leader is always causing you
trouble, so consider this an apology.
We don't have any girls in our club…
…so this is certainly a fresh experience…

The president's spellbound gaze was directed
at Nagato and Asahina.
Nagato displayed her usual poker face.

Whenever Asahina's eyes met the president's,
she lowered her face in embarrassment.

…We once extorted a computer from them in
one of Haruhi's schemes.

You'd expect the president to be recalling the
terrible things he's been put through.
Though, when you actually look at him…

I wish either one of those two would join our
club…
He mumbled something along those lines.
Without a doubt, my choice is Asahina.

As long as I have a cup of her tea, I feel like
I could endure any carnage.

On that front, it seems the computer society
members are of the same opinion.

Their twinkling eyes have been stealing
glances at Asahina for a while now.

Granted, it may only be because of the maid
outfit.

Well, between the two of them it would have to
be Nagato.

Asahina definitely heals you, but she won't be
the solution to the situation.

But with Nagato, she'll handle it quickly and
calmly like always.
Would you also like some tea, Kyon?

Before I knew it, Asahina had somehow become
completely absorbed in serving tea.

I wonder if it's a personality thing, or more
like some kind of work-related sickness?

Day-dreaming about such things, I sipped
Asahina's tea while lazily looking around.

There are a lot of different documents
scattered around…

There really are. Did you make these posters
on the computer?

Asahina pointed to a poster sitting on a
desk, and a member nodded.

Th-this kind of thing is nothing. Anyone could
do it. Easy-peasy.

Despite that, he's looking awfully proud of
himself. I'll take a look at it I guess.
…Eh.

"Value the water!” Is this supposed to raise
awareness of water conservation?

It was a request from the student council.
Not bad, right?

It's amazing how such a primitive device is
able to produce such a beautiful poster.

Asahina nodded as her eyes widened in
amazement.

However, that's not how you should show your
admiration. Please be more careful.

Though… When I look at this poster, there's
something that catches my attention.

The symbol "H2O,” which is to say, "water” is
rendered digitally, but…

For some reason, I got the impression that
something was off about it.
…Ah, I get it.
What it should say is "H2O,” but…
The 2 was missing so it became "HO.”
Also, the "H” was stretched out too wide.

Depending on how you looked at it, the "HO”
seemed more like a "1-10.”
Should I point it out?

Although Asahina and Nagato's
entertainment did brighten the mood.
Would pointing it out put a damper on that?
So then, what should I do…?
Uhh, could I borrow you for a moment?
…What is it?
Yeah, I understand how you feel.

I'm getting in the way of you having fun
talking to Asahina.
Excuse me but, about this poster…
Isn't the "2” of this "H2O” missing here?
Eh?! That can't be right…

The club member took the poster and held it
right up to his face.
…Aaah, it really is!

It's drawn the same color as the background
so you can't see it at all!
Also, the letter "H” is definitely too wide.
It looks less like an H… and more like "1-1.”
Th-that too, now that you mention it…
It said "H2O”?
I was certain it read as "1-10”.

As is, I don't think it gets the intended
message across.

Wouldn't it be best take down the posters
you've already put up?

You should hurry and remake them. If you do
it now, I'm sure no one will notice.

Ugh, I guess so… Well, they'll be easy to
remake anyways.

It's going to be hard going around and
taking them all down though…

I chose to sympathize with the club member's
dejection.

Because thanks to this, I think I've got some
nice material to deceive Haruhi with.
Ah, would you like a second helping of tea?

I-is that okay? In that case, thank you very
much.
Yes, please wait just a moment.
Here.
Hya!
…Did you prepare it in advance?
Yes.

Th-thank you very much! Okay, here's your
tea.
Thanks… Ahh, it's delicious.

After being wined and dined by Nagato and
Asahina…

…the computer society was enveloped in a
warm and relaxed atmosphere.

Even if I had pointed out the mistake, the
mood wouldn't have been killed anyway, huh?
Is your brigade always like this?
What do you mean, "like this”?

The club president's gaze was on Nagato and
Asahina…

…who were making tea for each of the club
members.
Well… I don't know about that.

I'm used to seeing the scene of Asahina
diligently preparing tea, but…

I thought it seemed quite a rare sight to see
Nagato making it.
It's like this about half the time, I'd say.

You guys have it good, don't you… Seems like
fun, while our club is a mess.

I wouldn't complain if it were just that we have
no female members.

But, getting falsely accused of sexual
harassment by your lot's brigade chief…

Having the computer we bought with our club
budget plundered…

It's because we had so many awful
experiences in the first semester…

The club president slumped his shoulders and
began mumbling and grumbling.

Not good. If this goes on I have a feeling I'll
have to put up with all his idle complaining.

I'll just give vague responses to avoid the
topic. I should call out to Nagato or Asahina…

Heyyy, Nagato! Could you get another
serving of tea for the president?
…Here.
That was fast!
Th-thank you.

Hm? What's up? Why are you staring at the
computer?

Are you interested in computers, by any
chance?
I can teach you if you'd like?
…It's fine.
Not right now.
I-I see…

Being coldly rejected, the president slumped
his shoulders.

…Even if it was just flattery, you should've
said "I'm really interested~” or something.

…Well, I can't imagine Nagato saying
something like that anyway.
Asahinaaa!

Please bring Mr. President another serving of
tea~
Y-yes, I'll be right there.

She responded in a slightly high-pitched voice
and brought over the teapot.
H-[#W20Here] you go.

Asahina came over right away, but she was
behaving awkwardly again.

Could it be that she was reminded of the
incident…

…where Haruhi made the club president do
that outrageous thing to her?
It's okay, Asahina.

Haruhi isn't here, so nothing will happen to
you.
I-I suppose you're right…

…A-are you always put through horrible
experiences like that?!

No one would blame you if you just resigned
from such a horrible group…

I'm sorry, I have circumstances that prevent
me from doing that…
I-I understand… What a cruel person…

I get the feeling the club president is
misunderstanding that Haruhi is…

…taking advantage of some weakness of
hers… Well, it's not something worth correcting.

Either way, the atmosphere in the computer
society has brightened.

On the other hand, I wasn't particularly able
to get any new information.

After all, I've come here to gather information
once before.

Haruhi already made you spill everything, so
there's no way there's anything else to tell.

Asahina, Nagato, we had better head back
soon.

What in the world did you guys even come here
for?
Was it really just to treat us to tea?

Unfortunately, that somehow seems to be the
case.

I shrugged. The president sensed something
in my response, and gave a sigh of relief.

I see… You lot have it rough as well. I
sympathize with you.
Thanks for that.

I can't believe I'm saying this, but for the time
being I feel united with our neighbor squad.
Asahina
Nagato
Point it out
Don't point it out
Call Nagato
Call Asahina
